concerns.location: plan.md:Data Model section (entities listed in data-model.md)
concerns.text: The plan references several output artifacts (mixed‑effects summary CSV, power‑analysis CSV, visualizations PNG, and results_summary.csv) that are not defined as entities in data-model.md, leaving no single source of truth for their schema or required fields.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 1 – Data Ingestion & Preprocessing (tasks T023, T024)
concerns.text: The text‑data contract (text-data.schema.yaml) requires metadata fields such as total_stories, sample_size, checksum, and event_boundary_method, but the plan only mentions creating raw .jsonl files without generating a corresponding metadata file that satisfies the contract.

The RSA‑output contract (rsa-output.schema.yaml) expects a structured JSON/YAML object containing rsa_matrix metadata (model_type, roi, similarity_metric, shape) and a permutation_result object with specific fields. The plan only states that CSV files will be written and does not describe producing a contract‑compliant metadata file, so the contract is not fully exercised.
